hypotheses.construction_plan: Start from the latent template M(n,n) with parameter n. Specialize the parameter to n=1 for the first member and n=2 for the second member. The raw expression is the sum of these two specializations.
required_assumptions: M is a function defined at the pairs (1,1) and (2,2)
hypotheses.rationale: Both summands are diagonal evaluations of the same binary function M, differing only in the evaluation point. They fit a common one-parameter template M(n,n) evaluated at n=1 and n=2.
